query:
SELECT r.record_id
         FROM mirror_records r
         JOIN mirror_record_legs l ON l.record_id = r.record_id
         WHERE r.author = $1 AND r.family = $2
           AND l.leg IN ('binary', 't') AND l.target = $3
         ORDER BY r.epoch DESC, r.act_time DESC, r.position DESC
         LIMIT 1
